name: Cummins
key_signal: CMI has broken below its 50-day moving average with negative MACD momentum and a 7.4% 21-day drawdown, even as trailing earnings growth sits at -21% against a still-rich 33.7x trailing P/E.
thesis: Longer-term trend remains intact (above 200dma, golden cross, +15% over 126 days) and the market is pricing a sharp earnings recovery, with forward P/E collapsing to 19x from 33.7x trailing — implying nearly 77% forward EPS growth. ROE of 22% and operating margins near 9.8% show underlying profitability is solid, and a 'buy' consensus among 19 analysts reflects confidence that the current cyclical dip in engines/heavy-truck demand is transitory.
bear_case: The near-term technical picture is deteriorating — price is down 7.4% over the last month, sitting below its 50dma with RSI at 43 and a negative MACD histogram (-4.7), signaling momentum has turned before any earnings inflection is confirmed. Trailing earnings growth of -21% alongside anemic revenue growth of just 2.7% suggests the cyclical machinery/trucking downturn is still working through results, and the stock trades at a demanding 7.2x book value and 33.7x trailing earnings for a business carrying 61.6x debt-to-equity — leaving little margin for disappointment if the forward-PE-implied recovery slips, especially with 45.7% annualized volatility amplifying any guidance miss.'
